title: Trump Tells UN He Could 'Annihilate' Iran, Expects Deal After Midterms
detail: In his address to the UN General Assembly, President Trump said he faced a choice between reaching a deal with Iran after the November midterm elections or moving to "annihilate the Islamic Republic" and "drive them into hell," while defending his administration's handling of the Iran conflict and other global crises before world leaders.

media.caption: Trump addresses the UN General Assembly on Iran policy
